question: Why did God stir up trouble between Abimelek and the citizens of Shechem?
options: To make Gaal king of Israel
To bring Midian back into the land
So the crime against Jerub-Baal's seventy sons would be avenged
explanation: God did this so that the violence done to the seventy sons of Jerub-Baal would be avenged on Abimelek and on the citizens of Shechem who helped him.
